en.headline: Victoria Park lantern displays extended to 7 October
en.dek: The Tourism Board and Leisure and Cultural Services Department said about 580,000 visits were recorded in 13 days, with one day topping 200,000.
body: The Mid-Autumn lantern displays at Victoria Park will stay up until 7 October so that they cover the National Day Golden Week, the Hong Kong Tourism Board and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department said on Wednesday.

The Tourism Board's International Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival and the department's Bing-Wu year lantern festival have been running since 17 September. From that date through 29 September they recorded about 580,000 visits, or an average of about 45,000 a day. The busiest single day exceeded 200,000 visits.
Organisers said crowd-control measures will be used when needed. Visitors were asked to follow instructions from staff on site.

Mid-Autumn Day has already passed, but the extension keeps the lantern streets and park displays open through the first week of October, when more local residents and incoming holiday travellers are expected in Causeway Bay.

zh.headline: 維園中秋絳燈展延至10月7日
zh.dek: 旅發局及康文署表示，9月17日至29日約58萬人次到訪，單日高峰超過20萬，展期覆蓋國慶黃金周。
body: 香港旅遊發展局及康樂及文化事務署星期三宣布，維多利亞公園的中秋絳燈展覽將延長至10月7日，涵蓋國慶黃金周假期。
旅發局的「國際中秋絳燈匯」及康文署的丙午年中秋絳燈會自9月17日開展。截至9月29日的13天內，合共錄得約58萬人次到訪，平均每日約4萬5千人次，最高峰單日超過20萬人次。
主辦單位表示，會視乎人流按需要實施管理措施，並呼籲參觀人士遵從現場工作人員指示。
中秋正日已過，延長展期讓銅鑼灣維園的絳燈街及園內燈組在10月首周繼續開放，供市民及黃金周旅客參觀。
